# Bylda

> Bylda is an AI Sales Operating System. It gives every salesperson an AI Sales
> Operator that listens to customer conversations, understands them, updates the
> CRM automatically, drafts follow-ups, and prepares a ranked daily brief. It is
> not a CRM and not a dashboard — it runs in the background of the stack a team
> already uses.

## What it does

- **Captures every conversation** across Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams, plus email and calendar context. No notetaker bot joins the room and no rep has to switch it on.
- **Understands meaning, not keywords** — buying signals, objections, decision makers, competitive pressure, and risk inferred from what was said and what was not.
- **Writes the CRM automatically** — around 14 fields per call into Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive, or Microsoft Dynamics, two-way and in real time, including custom fields. Every write is traceable to a timestamp in the call, logged, and reversible.
- **Drafts follow-ups** in each rep's own voice, referencing the specifics of the conversation, ready to send in one click.
- **Prepares a Morning Brief** overnight: highest-impact deal, drafted messages, deal risk, and a forecast whose confidence derives from conversation signals rather than stage age.

## Key facts

- Category: AI Sales Operating System (conversation intelligence + CRM automation + execution)
- Pricing: Operator $89 per rep/month, Team $129 per rep/month, Enterprise custom. 20% off annually. Capture, transcription, analysis, and CRM writes are unlimited on every plan.
- Minimum: 5 seats on Operator and Team, 50 on Enterprise.
- Implementation: most teams are live in an afternoon. No data migration.
- Security: SOC 2 Type II, AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.3 in transit, SSO/SAML and SCIM, US/EU/UK data residency, GDPR and CCPA, HIPAA BAA on request.
- Model training: customer conversations are never used to train shared or third-party models. Contractual, with zero-retention agreements at every model provider.
- Typical results: about 6.5 hours per rep per week returned; CRM required-field completeness from roughly 41% to above 95% in a quarter.

## How it differs

- **Versus a CRM:** a CRM stores what a human types. Bylda does the typing and the judgment around it. You keep Salesforce or HubSpot.
- **Versus conversation intelligence (e.g. Gong):** those tools produce insight and hand it back to a human to act on. Bylda executes — writes the fields, drafts the message, schedules the meeting.
- **Versus revenue/forecasting platforms (e.g. Clari):** those analyse whatever is already in the CRM, so accuracy is bounded by what reps entered. Bylda populates the CRM from the conversations first.
